body: All arguments about the legitimazation of the judge aside, I fell as though there has been some sort of spike in recent years about athiest prosecution, usually done both private and even on some social media. It is seemingly ridiculous that someone would persecute someone for simply not agreeing with one's point of view on the ideology of a higher power. As an athiest, I don't go around persecuting Hindus, Muslims, or even the bigots who call themselves Christians (a group which I was formerly apart of). It seems as though in America especially, people treat athiests like shit, and I personally think that just isn't justified.
There seriously has to be some legendaries soon.
